FY2024 three-segment profit is CNY 3.132bn, below CNY 3.7bn; adjusted parent profit is also below CNY 3.4bn.
The segment-level subsidy attribution is unproven, but FY2024 three-segment profit is CNY 3.132bn, below the condition's CNY 3.2bn lower bound.
The comparable required profit measures are complete and all preceding conditions fail.
